sql: SELECT timestamp,log_attributes['request.headers.cf_ray'] AS gateway_id,log_attributes['request.headers.x_request_id'] AS request_id,log_attributes['response.headers.x_request_id'] AS response_id,log_attributes['response.status_code'] AS status,log_attributes['response.origin_time'] AS origin_ms,log_attributes['request.headers.content_length'] AS bytes,CASE WHEN position(log_attributes['request.path'],'/parcels/')>0 THEN 'booking_photo' WHEN position(log_attributes['request.path'],'/verifications/')>0 THEN 'verification_photo' ELSE 'other' END AS kind,arrayFilter(k->positionCaseInsensitive(k,'request_id')>0 OR positionCaseInsensitive(k,'duration')>0,mapKeys(log_attributes)) AS correlation_fields FROM logs WHERE source='edge_logs' AND startsWith(log_attributes['request.path'],'/storage/v1/object/parcel_images/') AND log_attributes['request.method'] IN('POST','PUT') ORDER BY timestamp LIMIT 12
